During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a '''Mandalorian''' invited [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] to study the [[Bone/Legends|bones]] of several ancient [[Mythosaur/Legends|mythosaurs]], hoping to repopulate the extinct [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|Memories of the Mythosaurs}}</ref>
